title: Three stages of the funnel
instructions: Each stage needs its own message and its own metric.

tabs.label: Awareness
tabs.text:
Reach people who have never heard of the brand.

- Main metric: **reach** and **CPM**
- Typical channels: video, display, paid social

tabs.label: Consideration
tabs.text:
Help interested people compare options.

- Main metric: **CTR** and engaged visits
- Typical channels: search, retargeting, email

tabs.label: Conversion
tabs.text:
Turn intent into a purchase or a lead.

- Main metric: **CPA** and **ROAS**
- Typical channels: search, shopping, retargeting
